title: Roller Coaster Challenge
description:
Start by choosing a challenge card and setting up the pieces to match. Then, players use the remaining pieces to build a working roller coaster that meets the build conditions on their challenge card. Roller Coaster Challenge incorporates elements of a logic puzzle, while also allowing for the creativity that stems from free-form building. Once you have solved each challenge, you get to watch a real coaster car glide down the track, complete with dips, curves, and loops!

Roller Coaster Challenge is one of ThinkFun's most popular stem toys for boys and girls, and was a Toy of the Year Award Finalist in 2018. It's a logic game and roller coaster building set that comes with 60 challenges of increasing difficulty, from beginner to expert, and makes a great birthday or holiday present for kids who like smart games and challenging activities. Roller Coaster Challenge is a fun brain teaser puzzle made with high quality components, and comes with a very clear and easy to understand instruction manual - you'll be able to play within minutes of opening the box. Like all of ThinkFun's games, Roller Coaster Challenge is built to develop critical thinking skills and ties into STEM subjects like science and engineering. Playing through increasingly difficult challenges will improve logical reasoning, spatial reasoning and planning skills, all through fun gameplay.

title: Balance Beans
description:
Wobbling on a balance board is fun, but keeping steady is even better! Place the colorful beans in just the right spaces on the board to make it level. When the Pointer Bean aligns with the green section and the beans and board are balanced - YOU WIN! With 40 increasingly challenging puzzles, Balance Beans helps develop logical reasoning and early math skills and is the perfect introduction to the world of logic games for kids ages 5+. 

This updated version of Balance Beans features refreshed packaging and improved components for an even smoother game experience. Designed by the trusted minds at ThinkFun, Balance Beans blends education with entertainment, proving that learning math can be balanced, silly, and bean-tastically fun!

title: Math Dice
description:
Roll the two 12-sided Target Dice and multiply them to get a target number. Roll the three Scoring Dice and combine these numbers using addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, or even powers to build an equation that is closest or equal to the target. This mental challenge helps players sharpen math skills by solving problems in a fun new way.

Math Dice is fun, challenging, and encourages kids to grow their Math skills through play!  Perfect for at-home and the classroom, Math Dice is a regular favorite for making Math fun!

title: Word A Round
description: Who knew that positioning a word in one continuous ring would make it so tricky to read? Be the first to decipher and shout out the word on each WordARound card, and you win that card. collect the most cards and you win the game. A fun, fast-paced card game that will be the life of any party!

title: Cat Crimes
description: Cat Crimes is a single-player deductive reasoning-game with a lovable cast of characters-who may be up to no good! Each of the 40 challenge cards presents a crime and a series of clues to help solve it. There are 6 cat suspects to choose from, each with their own characteristics and identifying traits, and a game board that features supporting evidence. Grab your magnifying glass and sharpen your wits, it will take all your detective skills to solve these diabolical Cat Crimes!

title: Fifteen Puzzle
description:
One of the world's most recognized and popular brainteasers, the classic Fifteen Puzzle has been a favorite for generations. Players scramble the numbers and then attempt to slide them back in order from 1 to 15. The Fifteen Puzzle travels easily for an on-the-go challenge and its retro design appeals to puzzlers of all ages!

Its durable, high-quality construction ensures that the puzzle withstands the rigors of everyday play, and its compact size makes it an ideal travel companion for entertainment on the go. Whether for the classroom, as a gift, or for family game nights, the ThinkFun Fifteen Puzzle is sure to provide hours of engaging, brain-stimulating fun. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this classic puzzle to your collection!

title: Zingo! 1-2-3
description: Build reading and counting skills with Zingo! 1-2-3. Match numbered spaces on your challenge card with number tiles revealed by the Zingo! Zinger. The first player with a full card wins the game by yelling "Zingo!" Two levels of play focus on counting and addition. Zingo! 1-2-3 builds early number sense skills in young players as they associate digits with images and text, and supports early math learning through counting and pattern recognition. This fast-paced game will have the whole family yelling "1-2-3 PLAY!"

title: Stuffie Sleepover
description:
Perfect for children ages 5 and up, this engaging puzzle challenges kids to arrange a group of adorable stuffed animals around a sleeping child, fostering critical thinking and problem-solving skills in a playful way.

With 40 Challenges from Easy to Super Hard, Stuffie Sleepover will offer hours of adorable entertainment.

title: Sweet Victory
description:
In the game of Sweet Victory, players race to be the first to match their stacks with the image on the card! Once the card is flipped, it’s game on. Players can only use one hand to move their pieces. The first player to place the Trophy Topper onto their stand is the winner! But wait, that's just round one. Play through 12 lightning-fast rounds and the player with the most points wins!

Take strategic thinking into the fast lane with Sweet Victory. Perfect for game time with family and friends. Arrange the numbers and claim your trophy! For 2-4 players ages 8+!

title: Donut Detective
description:
With 40 progressive challenges, Donut Detective will offer hours of entertainment for anyone who likes to play with their food.  Challenges with positive and negative clues will work your brain on this tasty puzzle. 

Burn brain calories with each challenge and satiate those logic cravings!  Perfect for kids 8+ and kids at heart, especially if they love donuts.

title: Solitaire Chess Magnetic Travel Puzzle
description: Set up the magnetic pieces to match a Challenge, then capture and eliminate the pieces following the rules of traditional chess. The trick is: every move you make must capture another piece! When one piece is left standing - YOU WIN! The 120 challenges range from beginner to expert, and whether you’re a chess master or you’ve never played before, this is the perfect way to enjoy chess as a single-player game. With magnetic pieces and a self-contained playbook, it’s perfect for travel!
